Unfortunately not. A 5 ft fiddle leaf fig counts as an XL plant (usually over 4 ft), and XL plants ship Standard only, so Express isn't available. Standard takes at least 2-3 business days even in the closest zone (Zone 1), and live plants ship Monday-Wednesday only, so it can't arrive tomorrow.

If you ordered within the last 2 hours, you can cancel for free from "My Orders". After that, support can try to intercept the order before it ships, but that isn't guaranteed. If you'd like, I can escalate that request to a Support Lead.
